statement: For every odd n < 200001 whose first cube-odd landing x follows OOEOOEOO, x^3 >= n^8. This includes odd T(x). The even-T cases begin at n=4309. The ratio x^3/n^8 tracks n^{139/256} from the upper envelope x^{256} <= n^{729} and recedes from the eighth boundary as n grows. Full-word LowerPowerBound does not force the comparison below about 73-bit n. This is not a lower-cell theorem, not a defect restriction, and not a halt theorem.
